received_agent_messages.content:
Agent B requests information:
I need information for a Paris trip on November 15th with a 500 euro budget covering two meals (lunch and dinner) and a hotel. Please provide: 1) All restaurants in Paris that serve authentic French cuisine, including their names, ratings/reviews, prices, addresses, contact info, opening hours, and dietary restrictions. 2) All hotels in Paris including names, ratings/reviews, addresses, and minimum prices per night. I need to identify the top-rated French restaurant (suitable for lunch and dinner) and a highly-rated hotel that fits within the remaining budget after accounting for two meals at that restaurant.

Here is my full report for the Paris trip on November 15th with a 500 € budget (two meals + hotel).

## 1) Restaurants serving authentic French cuisine (4 total)

| Restaurant | Rating | Price/person | Address | Phone | Opening hours | Dietary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Le Baratin** | **4.8** | €30 | 3 Rue Jouye-Rouve, 75020 Paris | +33 1 43 49 39 70 | 12:00–2:00 PM & 7:30–10:30 PM; open Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat | Gluten-free available |
| Bistrot Paul Bert | 4.5 | €40 | 18 Rue Paul Bert, 75011 Paris | +33 1 43 72 24 01 | 12:00–2:30 PM & 7:00–10:30 PM; open Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri | Vegan available |
| Chez L'Ami Jean | 4.4 | €24 | 27 Rue Malar, 75007 Paris | +33 1 47 05 86 89 | 12:00–2:00 PM & 7:00–10:00 PM; open Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri | Vegan available |
| Breizh Café | 3.9 | €60 | 109 Rue Vieille du Temple, 75003 Paris | +33 1 42 72 13 77 | 9:00 AM–11:00 PM; open Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun | Vegetarian & gluten-free available |

**Top-rated French restaurant: Le Baratin (4.8)** — a small, cozy bistro with delicious homestyle cooking, a daily market-driven menu, and natural wine (cash only). It serves both lunch and dinner service and is the highest-rated French option.

⚠️ **Important note on Nov 15:** Le Baratin is only open Tue/Thu/Fri/Sat. November 15th is a **Saturday**, so it **is open** for both lunch and dinner. ✅

## 2) All hotels in Paris

| Hotel | Rating | Min price/night | Price range | Address |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Good Night** | **5.0** | **€240** | €240–400 | 15 Rue Cler, 75007 Paris |
| Luxury Palace | 5.0 | €500 | €500–1000 | 1 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris |
| Montmartre Suites | 4.7 | €110 | €110–200 | 23 Rue Lepic, 75018 Paris |
| Le Marais Boutique | 4.2 | €120 | €120–180 | 12 Rue des Archives, 75004 Paris |

## Recommendation & budget math
- **Restaurant:** Le Baratin (top-rated French, 4.8), €30/person → €30 lunch + €30 dinner = **€60 total for two meals** (single traveler).
- **Remaining budget for hotel:** €500 − €60 = **€440**.

**Hotel recommendation:** The highest-rated hotels are Good Night (5.0) and Luxury Palace (5.0). Only **Good Night** fits the remaining €440 budget (min €240/night); Luxury Palace starts at €500 and is over budget.

- **Good Night — Rating 5.0** — 15 Rue Cler, 75007 Paris, France — min €240/night. Reviews: very clean and quiet, central location, friendly staff, spacious room with Eiffel Tower view, delicious breakfast. **This is the best fit.**

(For reference, Montmartre Suites (4.7, €110) and Le Marais Boutique (4.2, €120) are also well within budget but lower-rated. Note Montmartre Suites' reviewers flagged noise/non-soundproof rooms.)
